pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.2: tena kho pana samayena Thullanandā bhikkhunī saṃghena samanubhaṭṭhā bhikkhuniyo evaṃ vadeti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.3: saṃsaṭṭhā 'va ayye tumhe viharatha, mā tumhe nānā viharittha.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.4: santi saṃghe aññāpi bhikkhuniyo evācārā evaṃsaddā evaṃsilokā bhikkhunīsaṃghassa vihesikā aññamaññissā vajjapaṭicchādikā, tā saṃgho na kiñci āha.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.5: tumhañ ñeva saṃgho uññāya paribhavena akkhantiyā vebhassiyā dubbalyā evam āha: bhaginiyo kho saṃsaṭṭhā viharanti pāpācārā pāpasaddā pāpasilokā bhikkhunīsaṃghassa vihesikā aññamaññissā vajjapaṭicchādikā. viviccath' ayye, vivekañ ñeva bhaginīnaṃ saṃgho vaṇṇetīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā Thullanandā saṃghena samanubhaṭṭhā bhikkhuniyo evaṃ vakkhati:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.11: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave Thullanandā bhikkhunī saṃghena samanubhaṭṭhā bhikkhuniyo evaṃ vadeti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.17: hi nāma bhikkhave Thullanandā bhikkhunī saṃghena samanubhaṭṭhā bhikkhuniyo evaṃ vakkhati:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.24: saṃsaṭṭhā 'va ayye tumhe viharatha, mā tumhe nānā viharittha;
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.25: santi saṃghe aññāpi bhikkhuniyo evācārā evaṃsaddā evaṃsilokā bhikkhunīsaṃghassa vihesikā aññamaññissā vajjapaṭicchādikā, tā saṃgho na kiñci āha;
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.26: tumhañ ñeva saṃgho uññāya paribhavena akkhantiyā vebhassiyā dubbalyā evam āha: bhaginiyo kho saṃsaṭṭhā viharanti pāpācārā pāpasaddā pāpasilokā bhikkhunīsaṃghassa vihesikā aññamaññissā vajjapaṭicchādikā; viviccath' ayye, vivekañ ñeva bhaginīnaṃ saṃgho vaṇṇetīti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.27: sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi evam assa vacanīyā:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.32: evañ ca sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi vuccamānā tath' eva paggaṇheyya, sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbā tassa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.33: yāvatatiyañ ce samanubhāsiyamānā taṃ paṭinissajjeyya, icc etaṃ kusalaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:1.34: no ce paṭinissajjeyya, ayam pi bhikkhunī yāvatatiyakaṃ dhammaṃ āpannā nissāraṇīyaṃ saṃghādisesan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:2.24: aññāhi bhikkhunīhi yā passanti yā suṇanti tāhi vattabbā:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:2.47: ayaṃ itthannāmā bhikkhunī saṃghena samanubhaṭṭhā bhikkhuniyo evaṃ vadeti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:3.14: uddiṭṭhā kho ayyāyo sattarasa saṃghādisesā dhammā,
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:3.16: yesaṃ bhikkhunī aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā āpajjitvā tāya bhikkhuniyā ubhatosaṃghe pakkhamānattaṃ caritabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:3.17: ciṇṇamānattā bhikkhunī yattha siyā vīsatigaṇo bhikkhunīsaṃgho, tattha sā bhikkhunī abbhetabbā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:3.18: ekāya pi ce ūnavīsatigaṇo bhikkhunīsaṃgho taṃ bhikkhuniṃ abbheyya,
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:3.19: sā ca bhikkhunī anabbhitā tā ca bhikkhuniyo gārayhā, ayaṃ tattha sāmīci.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss13:3.26: parisuddh' etth' ayyāyo, tasmā tuṇhī, evam etaṃ dhārayāmīti.
